module_summary: Frame length adjuster with FIFOs: a length-adjust core pads/truncates frames into a deep frame data FIFO while per-frame length status is queued in a small header FIFO.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input frame data into the length-adjust core.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input stream valid into the length-adjust core.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready from the length-adjust core.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Adjusted frame data read from the frame FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output data valid from frame FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready for frame FIFO read side.

anchors.name: m_axis_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Header valid from header FIFO announcing per-frame length info.

anchors.name: m_axis_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream ready popping the header FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axis_hdr_length
anchors.why: Adjusted frame length from header FIFO.

anchors.name: length_min
anchors.why: Minimum frame length config; shorter frames are padded.

anchors.name: length_max
anchors.why: Maximum frame length config; longer frames are truncated.

anchors.name: fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Padded/truncated stream from adjust core into frame FIFO.

anchors.name: fifo_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid from adjust core into frame FIFO.

anchors.name: fifo_axis_tready
anchors.why: Frame FIFO ready back-pressuring the adjust core.

anchors.name: status_valid
anchors.why: Per-frame status valid pushing length record into header FIFO.

anchors.name: status_ready
anchors.why: Header FIFO ready accepting status record.

anchors.name: status_frame_length
anchors.why: Adjusted length field packed into header FIFO word.

groups.name: length_adjust_core
groups.description: Adjust core padding short and truncating long frames per min/max.

groups.name: frame_fifo
groups.description: Deep data FIFO buffering adjusted frames to the output stream.

groups.name: header_fifo
groups.description: Small FIFO queuing per-frame pad/truncate/length header records.
